subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should `sessions.list.presentation` become a permanent Gateway protocol contract with these closed family and title-source enums?
rationale: This introduces cross-client presentation policy and permanent protocol vocabulary; tests can validate implementation but cannot decide the long-term ownership and enum-evolution contract.

options.title: Adopt the Gateway contract
options.body: Approve Gateway ownership, require forward-compatible enum semantics and regenerated client contracts, then land the coordinated client work.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Expose only stable semantic fields such as family and background state while leaving localized titles to each client.

options.title: Keep presentation client-owned
options.body: Decline the protocol addition and continue using client-side session-key and display-name handling.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Gateway contract
recommendation.body: Approve Gateway ownership, require forward-compatible enum semantics and regenerated client contracts, then land the coordinated client work.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked product proposal and coordinated both producer and consumer implementations.
